title: Unit 6 Stand-alone 3: Hiatal Hernia Client Teaching

question.stem: Which of the following statements by the client would indicate a correct understanding of the teaching?
question.preamble: The nurse has taught a client with a hiatal hernia about interventions for the condition.

options.text: “Wearing an abdominal binder can help relieve symptoms.”
“I should elevate the head of the bed on 6 in (15 cm) blocks.”
“Eating foods with a high fat content will increase gastric emptying.”

question.explanation: Elevating the head of the bed reduces nighttime reflux and is standard hiatal hernia/GERD teaching. Small, frequent meals are recommended instead of 3 regular-sized meals (Option 1), to reduce abdominal pressure. An abdominal binder (Option 2) increases intra-abdominal pressure and would worsen symptoms. High-fat foods (Option 4) delay, rather than increase, gastric emptying, which worsens reflux risk.
